canada.title: B.C. teen who moved schools for volleyball denied competitive play by transfer bylaw
canada.summary: A 16-year-old B.C. teen who moved from Hudson's Hope to Fort St. John to attend a school with a senior girls volleyball team won't be allowed to play this year because of a longstanding bylaw on athlete transfers.

canada.title: Family of injured Wainwright soldier holds bedside vigil in burn unit

canada.summary: The province announced the new joint-use school is 70 per cent complete and set to open next September.

canada.title: Committee backs bigger, YMCA-run pool on Saskatoon's east side
canada.summary: City administration had recommended moving ahead with a less ambitious hybrid model featuring a six-lane pool with a 4,000-square-foot fitness area, run by the YMCA as a city facility. But Coun. Zach Jeffries, whose ward is located on the east side of the city and who has long advocated for the new facility, proposed a bigger option.

canada.title: Man whose arm was broken in arrest attempt says he's scared to go to court after RCMP officer charged

canada.title: Bay Roberts auto shops fed up with string of wheel thefts

canada.title: Fewer Montrealers are placing bets, but online gambling has tripled: new study
